title: SpaceX prepares to send Starship rocket to orbit for first time - CNBC
description: Elon Musk's SpaceX is poised to launch a historic test flight of its massive Starship rocket early Monday.

title: Benjamin Satterley Dies One Day After Match: AEW Wrestler Known As “Pac” Was 40 - Deadline

title: White House expands taxpayer-paid ad campaign boosting Trump - The Washington Post
description: The taxpayer-funded campaign borrows the president's political rhetoric as the White House defends the spots as “public service” announcements.
